data.name: Void Resurgence
data.detailed_description:
🚀 ✦ PILOT A STARSHIP INTO THE VOID ✦ 🚀

You are the pilot of a starship venturing into a newly discovered dimension filled with vibrant energy and mysterious matter. As you navigate this neon wilderness, you'll encounter distress signals and opportunities to complete side missions that reward you with valuable resources and upgrades.
  

⚔️ ✦ BULLET-HELL COMBAT ✦ ⚔️

Battle against swarms of alien enemies and colossal bosses. Every fight is a test of your strategy. Collect resources to upgrade your starship in real-time. Master pixel-perfect bullet-hell gameplay and near-miss escapes.

Discover 20 core systems, merge them to unlock 16 devastating Hyper Powers, game-changing abilities that can turn the tide of any battle. No two runs are ever the same.
    

🎮 ✦ PLAY YOUR WAY ✦ 🎮

Choose from four difficulty levels that match your playstyle. Whether you're seeking a relaxed cosmic journey or a hardcore bullet-hell challenge, Void Resurgence adapts to you.
  

⭐ ✦ PROGRESSION & COMPETITION ✦ ⭐

Death is only the beginning. Earn permanent upgrades for your starship that carry over between runs. Unlock 10 ship classes, each with different starting weapons.

Test your skills against pilots from around the world. Compete in over 420 global leaderboards. Prove your mastery and etch your name among the stars as a true ace.

data.short_description: Command a starship in Void Resurgence, a retro-futuristic space roguelite. Battle through colorful cosmic fields, collect upgrades, and build your ultimate ship. Dodge intense bullet-hell patterns and fight for survival. Every run offers new challenges and permanent progress.
